messages:
noah: Quick callout— p50 on the endpoint detail page is sometimes higher than p95 on the overview for the same minute. Saw it on /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate. Not a UI glitch? :grimacing:

priya: whoa that's alarming. Any example timestamps?

noah: 2024-10-05T14:21Z window. p50 detail = 210ms, overview p95 = 180ms for same minute. Screenshot in thread.

cheng: initial theory: we might be pulling p50 from a different ingestion (edge-proxy samples) while overview p95 uses merged tdigest that excludes synthetic retries. If heavy retries land in detail but are filtered in overview, order can flip.

emi: also possible: p50 is computed from raw histogram shards that had quantization bug (bucket boundaries off by +10ms) for a brief deploy. I traced histogram metadata change around 14:20 but couldn't conclude.

noah: I ran a diff on sketches:

```
-- pseudo
select minute, approx_percentile(sketch_raw,0.5) p50_raw from proxy_hist where route = '/v1/embeddings' and minute = '2024-10-05T14:21Z';
select minute, approx_percentile(merged_sketch,0.95) p95_merged from merged_sketches where route = '/v1/embeddings' and minute = '2024-10-05T14:21Z';
```

those returned values matching what I saw. The raw sketch had 20% of samples from a fallback path that the merge job later de-duped/attributed differently.

priya: if fallback samples are heavy but few, they can move medians more than p95 sometimes. Example: 100 samples at 100ms, 5 fallback at 2s -> p50 stays ~100ms, p95 jumps to 2s normally, but if merge excludes fallbacks for p95 (bug), p95 could be lower. This explains inversion only if the signals are using different filters.

cheng: proposed fix: enforce a single canonical "telemetry view" per dashboard tile. Options:
- canonical = merged_post_routing (used by SLOs)
- expose a small selector "view: ingress | post-routing | ingress+retries"
- show provenance label with link to the exact query used

emi: UX note: many customers look at detail to investigate anomalies. If overview and detail disagree they lose trust. I'd bias default to post-routing for everything and expose ingress as opt-in for fast detection.

noah: Tradeoffs: post-routing is authoritative but can lag (merge latency ~30-50s). Fast detection (ingress) helps on-callers but will increase noise. We should add clear labeling and a visual treatment: ingress = dashed orange line, authoritative = solid blue.

priya: also add a telemetry API param so internal tooling and monitors can request `quantile_source=canonical|ingress`. Example: GET /api/v1/metrics?route=/v1/embeddings&quantile=0.95&source=canonical

cheng: backend note: our tdigest merge pipeline marks records with sample_origin = {ingress, routed, retry}. We can add a webpack toggle to the console to pick source. Minimal backend change: support query param `source` in metrics proxy that picks the tdigest table or the ingress stream table.

emi: testing: add unit tests that assert p50/p95 monotonicity on the same source for same minute (p50 <= p95). If we detect inversion in prod telemetry, log and create a ticket automatically. This will catch any future mismatched sources.

noah: good idea. Also add an explain link on the metric panel that shows the SQL used and the sample counts per origin. Helps debugging.

deploy-bot: frontend PR created: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/3612 - adds source selector, provenance badge, and legend styles. Backend PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9140 - supports `source` query param.

priya: copy suggestions for the badge: "Source: canonical (post-routing). This view includes retries and routing attribution and is used for SLOs. Switch to 'ingress' for earlier, noisier signal."

cheng: I'll update infra PR to return {counts_by_origin} in the metrics response so the console can show small bars for ingress/routed/retry breakdown.

emi: follow-up ops decision: default dashboards (SLO, Overview, Alerts) use canonical. Per-tenant consoles can flip to ingress. Also add a flag `console.metrics_preference` in tenant config with default 'canonical'.

noah: can we also schedule a short runbook blurb for oncall? "If overview vs detail disagree: check metric source & counts_by_origin. If counts_by_origin shows >10% retries, expect divergence."

priya: adding that to runbooks now. Assigning follow-ups: frontend PR (emi), infra changes (cheng), unit tests + e2e (noah).

emi: will include an e2e that mocks merged latency with delayed merge to assert the badge text appears and selector toggles sources.

noah: thanks. Let's watch next week's Monday morning alerts to see if this reduces confusion. :coffee:
